description: This file provides mock functions, test harness setup, and utility functions for testing the 'bot-message-context' route in a Telegram bot extension. It primarily facilitates unit testing by mocking external dependencies and providing functions to access recorded calls.

methods.name: loadTelegramMessageContextRouteHarness
methods.description: Asynchronously loads and returns dependencies needed for testing the Telegram message context route, including configuration setters and test builders.

methods.name: getRecordedUpdateLastRoute
methods.description: Retrieves the 'updateLastRoute' property from the last or specified call to the 'recordInboundSessionMock'.
